Job description:
✅Shahd Knowledge-Based Cultural and Artistic Institute (Animation Producer) is looking for a male Artificial Intelligence expert for a domestic animation series project and an international series for a minimum of one year. Employment conditions: Experience in AI animation production, familiar with After Effects and Premiere, maximum age 30, belief in the destruction of Israel. Type of cooperation: In-person / Full-time / One year. Suitable salary + insurance. Work area: Tehran, Enghelab Square. Possibility of attracting knowledge-based companies also exists.

Company description:
Shahd Studio is a knowledge-based animation production company that has produced more than 2000 minutes of serial animation with 15 years of experience and has broadcast them in English, Arabic, Urdu, and Persian on various domestic and foreign networks.
